tips.text: Throw Five Point Strike so the enemy is at the tip of the arc, because only the tip leaves them slowed.
Watch your energy bar. Five Point Strike costs a lot, so don't spam it and leave yourself empty when the enemy fights back.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape a bad fight. It makes you invisible and fast, and it refills your energy.
Attacking or casting inside Twilight Shroud breaks your invisibility. Area spells can also reveal you, so don't treat it as a perfect hiding spot.
Cast Shuriken Flip, then recast it to dash to the marked enemy. It can also mark a smoke cloud, so you can use it to escape or close in.
Save Perfect Execution for when the enemy is hurt. The second dash hits harder the lower their health is, so wait to recast it until they are low.
After you hit an enemy with an ability, step out of the ring around them. Your next attack then has longer range and deals bonus damage.

combos.name: Ultimate between dashes
combos.when: When engaging a target and you want the ultimate to start mid-dash.
combos.text: Perfect Execution can be cast during the Shuriken Flip recast dash. Casting it there saves time on the engage and gives the target less time to react.

tips.text: Cast Twilight Shroud to turn invisible and walk away from danger. Attacking or casting a spell breaks the invisibility for a moment.
Throw Shuriken Flip at an enemy or at your own smoke, then recast it to dash to the mark. The dash can cross walls.
Use Five Point Strike at the edge of its range. Only enemies hit by the tip are slowed, and it hits harder when you have full energy.
After you hit a champion with a spell, step out of the ring around them. Your next attack then has extra range and damage.
Go for fragile champions at the back after your team starts the fight. Use Perfect Execution to jump in, then recast it to finish a weakened target.
Save Twilight Shroud for escaping and for refilling energy before a trade. It adds to your max energy while the smoke is up.

combos.name: Shroud into Shuriken dash
combos.when: When you want to close distance on a target from inside the smoke without being seen coming.
combos.text: Throw the shuriken so it marks the smoke cloud, then recast to dash through it. You get a stealthy gap close and can follow with your other spells.

combos.name: Dash buffered Five Point Strike
combos.when: When dashing onto a target and you want the kunai to go out the moment you land.
combos.text: Press Q during the recast dash and it buffers, casting as soon as the dash ends. This saves time and keeps the damage tight.

tips.text: Use Five Point Strike at its far edge so the enemy is slowed, and you can poke Aatrox without being easy to catch.
Step out of The Darkin Blade's long first strike and its wide sweep, and trade back while his ability is on cooldown.
Drop Twilight Shroud when Aatrox commits to a fight. It makes you invisible, and your speed boost lets you walk away.
Leave Infernal Chains by moving to the side before the pull happens.
Use Perfect Execution to finish Aatrox when he is low on health, because the second dash hits harder against low-health targets.
Use Shuriken Flip to dash in and out of a trade, and take the second cast when you want to get away.
Use Twilight Shroud to turn invisible when Briar leaps at you; her frenzy can still lock onto you, so keep your distance and stay moving.
Hit Briar with Five Point Strike at the edge of its range so she is slowed. Without that, she closes the gap fast.
Save Shuriken Flip to escape or to chase a fleeing Briar. Its recast dash tracks the marked target and has no range limit.
Fight Briar when she is low on health, since Perfect Execution hits harder on missing health. Do not chase a Briar who is healing.
Poke Darius from the edge of range with Five Point Strike; at long range it also leaves him slowed, so he can't catch you.
Stay out of Apprehend's reach; if he pulls you in, he gets a free trade.
Fight him when Apprehend is on cooldown. Then he has no way to drag you back.
Drop Twilight Shroud to disengage when he closes in. Don't stay in melee, because Hemorrhage stacks up fast.
Shuriken Flip's recast gets you out or in. Use it to leave after a trade, since Darius has little reach to chase you.
Save Perfect Execution to finish Darius once he is low. Don't use it while he is healthy, because Decimate heals him.
Do not use Five Point Strike or Shuriken Flip into Fiora while she can use Riposte; she blocks the damage and slows or stuns you back.
Bait Riposte with a cheap poke, then trade once it is on cooldown.
Hit Five Point Strike at its tip so Fiora is slowed and cannot easily close in with Lunge.
Hold Perfect Execution until Riposte is spent, then kill her with the second thrust once she is hurt.
Use Twilight Shroud to disengage when Fiora commits to a fight; smoke hides you and the speed gets you away.
Hit Gangplank with Five Point Strike at its maximum range so he is slowed and you can poke without being punished.
Stay out of range of his Powder Keg explosions; they slow you and hurt a lot. Walk around kegs you see instead of through them.
Wait until Remove Scurvy is used before going all in; it cleanses crowd control and heals him.
Use Twilight Shroud to break line of sight and reset the fight when he has kegs ready.
Watch for level 6; Cannon Barrage can hit you anywhere on the map, so do not sit low on health.
Fight Garen from long range with Five Point Strike; his slow only lands on enemies at the tip, so poke him from max range and step back.
Garen's Decisive Strike silences you on his next hit, so back off when he uses it. Do not walk into him while he has it ready.
Use Shuriken Flip to hit him, then recast to dash in. Flip back out before Judgment can spin on you for long.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape or reposition if he gets close. Pick when to attack from inside the smoke.
Keep trading while he is hurt, since Perseverance heals him only when he is not being hit. Keep poking so he cannot recover.
Save Perfect Execution to finish him once he is low, because the second dash hurts more the lower his health is.
Garen's Courage shield and damage reduction blunt a trade. Wait for it to end before going all in.
Fight when Jayce has used his Shock Blast or To the Skies!; his poke is weaker and he has less to punish you with.
Drop Twilight Shroud on yourself when Jayce tries to trade at range; you turn invisible and move faster, so his shots are hard to line up.
Throw Shuriken Flip at Jayce, then recast it to dash onto him. It also dashes you to a smoke cloud, which gives you a way to close or escape.
Use Perfect Execution on Jayce when he is low. Its second thrust hurts more the less health he has, so save it to finish him.
Stay at the tip of your range with Five Point Strike; Jayce is slowed there and has a harder time swinging his hammer at you.
Use Twilight Shroud to dodge K'Sante's all-in; he cannot easily follow once you are invisible inside the smoke.
Hit K'Sante with Five Point Strike at its tip so he is slowed, then step back out of his reach.
Stay out of Ntofo Strikes range. After one hit, the next one stuns and pulls you in.
Save Shuriken Flip to escape or to close the gap on a wounded K'Sante, rather than using it just to trade.
When K'Sante is All Out he has far less health, so look to kill him then with Perfect Execution.
Trade with Five Point Strike at long range so the enemy is slowed. Avoid fighting Malphite while his shield is up.
Malphite's Unstoppable Force can't be stopped once it starts. Keep Twilight Shroud or Shuriken Flip ready to get away from it.
Wait for his Seismic Shard to be spent before you go in. Without it he has trouble catching you.
Stay out of Ground Slam range between trades. It cuts your Attack Speed, which hurts your empowered attacks.
Stay out of Death's Grasp range and watch for it when you walk up to trade; being pulled in sets up Mordekaiser's combo.
Hit Mordekaiser with Five Point Strike at its edge so he is slowed, and do not stay in melee when his aura is active.
Do not burst into his Indestructible shield. Wait for it to fade, then trade.
Keep Perfect Execution or Shuriken Flip ready to escape once he has Realm of Death at level 6. Once you are inside, you are cut off from help.
Fight Rumble when he is Overheating, since he cannot cast spells then. Keep your distance from his basic attacks, which hit harder.
Use Five Point Strike at its tip to hit him and slow him. Stay out of his Flamespitter range when you can.
Do not stand in The Equalizer's fire. Leave with Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution rather than staying to trade.
Dodge Electro Harpoon where you can, since two hits slow you heavily and make you take more damage from your enemy's magic.
Stay out of Decimating Smash range while Sion charges it. Step sideways or dash away, because a long charge means a long stun.
Poke with Five Point Strike at max range so the enemy is slowed, and walk away before Sion can answer.
Use Shuriken Flip to escape or to reach Sion only when his Decimating Smash is on cooldown.
Do not finish Sion in a long fight. Glory in Death brings him back with fast, healing attacks, so back away until it ends.
Drop Twilight Shroud to break away when Sion starts charging his ultimate.
Stay out of Blinding Dart range when you can; the blind makes your attacks miss and ruins your Swinging Kama poke.
Look for Teemo mushrooms before dashing with Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution; landing on one slows you and reveals you.
Do not walk up and trade then back out; Toxic Shot keeps hurting you as you retreat. Commit fully or stay away.
Use Five Point Strike at long range to slow Teemo, and keep up your energy so you can follow up.
Check brush before you step in, since Teemo can hide there invisible while moving.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape after a trade, but shuriken or Five Point Strike can break it, so wait out the cooldown.
Fight Vayne when she has used Tumble; her short dash is her best way out of your burst.
Never stand with a wall behind you when Vayne has Condemn up; it stuns you and hurts.
Vayne is fragile, so jump on her with Perfect Execution once she is low, then finish with the second thrust.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape or to reset your energy after a trade.
Don't let Vayne attack you three times in a row; Silver Bolts deals extra damage on the third hit.
Throw Five Point Strike at its edge of range so the enemy is slowed, then use Shuriken Flip to stay on them or leave.
Do not stand in a line with Yone when Mortal Steel is ready. Two hits make it dash and knock you up.
Yone's Fate Sealed stuns and pulls you in, so keep your own Perfect Execution ready for when he commits.
Fight him when Soul Unbound is on cooldown. Without it he cannot dash away or snap back to deal extra damage.
Use Twilight Shroud to reset an even fight and regain energy. Hold your energy for a burst when Yone is low.
Walk behind minions when Ahri has Charm ready; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions in the way soak it for you.
Trade with Five Point Strike when Ahri walks up to farm. Hit her at the tip of the kunai to leave her slowed.
Keep Perfect Execution for when Ahri is low on health. Her Spirit Rush is her escape, so wait until it is on cooldown to go in.
Use Twilight Shroud to break line of sight and walk out of Charm range. Ahri's Fox-Fire cannot home in on you while you are invisible.
Shuriken Flip flips you backward, so you can use it to step out of the path of an Orb of Deception.
Trade with Five Point Strike at its far tip so the enemy is slowed, then back off before Akshan can answer.
Drop Twilight Shroud when you need to disengage or hide. Akshan can still hit you with area spells, and doing so briefly reveals you.
Hold Perfect Execution for when Akshan is low on health. The second thrust hurts most against a wounded target.
Use Shuriken Flip to mark Akshan, then recast to dash onto him once your Energy allows a follow-up.

comboRefs.note: Smoke gap close lets Akali approach Akshan unseen, then follow up with her other spells.

tips.text: Dodge Flash Frost by stepping sideways; it is wide and slow, so don't walk straight at Anivia.
Never dash in with Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution right after Crystallize goes down; the wall can block you and push you back.
Use Five Point Strike at its far edge to slow Anivia, then trade while her Frostbite is on cooldown.
Once Anivia turns into an egg, don't waste your ultimate on her; kill the egg or leave.
Fight Annie when she has no stun stored; with her counter lit, back off or stay out of her range.
Trade with Five Point Strike at its far tip so the enemy is slowed, and step back before she can answer.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape or reposition after a trade. Attacking or casting from inside it breaks your invisibility.
Use Shuriken Flip to dash in and out of range of Annie. The recast follows the marked target, so mark her or a smoke cloud before you commit.
Go for Annie with Perfect Execution when she has no stun ready, and use the recast to finish her once she is low.
Move away from Tibbers after Annie summons him, since he burns anyone close.
Wait for Aurelion Sol to use Singularity or Falling Star, then go in. Both are slow to land, and without them he has little to stop you.
Use Twilight Shroud to fight in smoke and to escape when he gets close, since the black hole drags enemies inward.
Stay out of the middle of Singularity. Enemies there below a certain Health die instantly, and he gets stronger as the game goes on.
Break line of sight or dash away when Breath of Light starts. It does more damage the longer it stays on you.
Use Perfect Execution to finish him once he has spent his abilities. Her second thrust hits harder the lower his Health is.
Use Shuriken Flip to jump onto him, or to get away when he is slowed or dragged. It can chase him across any distance.

comboRefs.note: Smoke hides the approach and the dash closes on Aurelion Sol, who has no listed way to stop a dash.

tips.text: Fight Aurora when she has used The Weirding; she is slow to get away and you can dash in with Shuriken Flip.
Use Twilight Shroud to hide when Aurora is ready to trade, and save your energy for a quick kill.
Hold Perfect Execution for when Aurora is low on health; the second thrust hurts more the less health she has.
Aurora's Across the Veil makes her invisible and lets her hop away. Keep Shuriken Flip ready to follow her.
Step out of Twofold Hex's line; it is a straight shot that curses you, and the recast hits harder on low health.

comboRefs.note: Smoke and the E dash let Akali close in unseen, which counters Aurora's slows and spirit-realm hops.

tips.text: Fight Azir when his Sand Soldiers are not near him. Without soldiers he cannot use Conquering Sands or Shifting Sands, so he has little way to respond.
Do not stand next to his soldiers. Their stabs hit hard and he can swing them at you from range, so trade from outside them.
Save Perfect Execution for when Azir has used Shifting Sands. He has no other dash to get away from you.
Take care when you chase him into his Emperor's Divide. It knocks you back, and the soldiers it leaves behind block your path for a while.
Drop Twilight Shroud to break his line of sight and walk away when he has his soldiers out. Do not stay in the fight on a long cooldown.

comboRefs.note: Dashing in with a buffered Q gets Akali's damage out at once before Azir's soldiers can react.

tips.text: Dodge Brand's Sear and Pillar of Flame. Without a first hit he cannot start his combo, so stay out of a straight line.
Do not sit in Twilight Shroud and think you are safe. Brand's Pillar of Flame hits an area and reveals you.
Go in with Perfect Execution once Brand's Sear is on cooldown. Without it he has little to stop you.
Back off when Brand has an unstable ring on you. Leave it before it explodes, because it hurts a lot.
Keep Twilight Shroud for when Briar leaps in; you turn invisible and gain speed to walk away from her forced attacks.
Poke with Five Point Strike at its far edge so Briar is slowed, and keep your distance before she can leap on you.
Hold Shuriken Flip as your escape; the flip sends you backward away from Briar, and you can recast it to dash to a marked target or smoke.
Use Perfect Execution on Briar when she is low, since its second thrust hurts more the less health she has. Her healing can undo it, so finish quickly.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as Petrifying Gaze goes off so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Avoid walking into Miasma; it grounds you, so Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution cannot get you out.
Dodge Noxious Blast by sidestepping after the cast; it lands after a short delay. Each hit speeds Cassiopeia up.
Fight her when her Miasma is on cooldown, since she has no way to stop your dash in.
Fight Diana when she has just used Lunar Rush with no Moonlight on the target; she has no quick way back in, so trade with Five Point Strike then.
Throw Five Point Strike at its edge so Diana is slowed and cannot close the gap easily.
Step out of Crescent Strike's path; if you are marked with Moonlight, expect Diana to dash onto you, so back off.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape when Diana jumps on you, but expect Moonfall to pull you out and reveal you.
Wait out Pale Cascade before you trade; its shield and orbs make early all-in fights poor.
Save Perfect Execution to finish Diana once she is low, and leave the fight if your Health is low when her Moonfall is ready.
Fight Ekko when his Chronobreak is on cooldown; he can't rewind out of your combo, so Perfect Execution can finish him.
Use Twilight Shroud to make Ekko lose sight of you, then hit him with Shuriken Flip and dash in when he steps toward the smoke.
Don't dash into the area of Parallel Convergence. If he enters it, you get stunned.
Sidestep Timewinder when you can. It comes back for a second hit, so avoid standing in its field.
Hit Ekko with Five Point Strike at the edge of its range so he is slowed and can't easily trade back.

comboRefs.note: Smoke dash closes in stealthily, which helps against Ekko, who has no listed way to see through it.
Buffered Q lands the moment the dash ends, keeping damage tight on Ekko's low-health frame.

tips.text: Stay out of Ezreal's Mystic Shot line behind minions, since it stops at the first enemy. Then close the gap.
Use Five Point Strike at its edge so it slows Ezreal, then follow with Shuriken Flip to close in.
Go for the kill when Ezreal has used Arcane Shift. Perfect Execution deals more damage to a low-health target and he is fragile.
Duck into Twilight Shroud to dodge his poke and reset your energy. Attacking or casting from inside it reveals you.

comboRefs.note: Smoke from Twilight Shroud lets Akali dash in with Shuriken Flip and close the gap on Ezreal.

tips.text: Stay out of Fizz's Playful / Trickster range when it is ready; he can hop out of your trades and punish you with a slow and burst.
Hold Perfect Execution until Fizz has used Playful / Trickster, because he cannot be targeted while he balances on his trident.
Hit Fizz with Five Point Strike at the tip of its range so he is slowed, then back away from his short-range dives.
Walk away from Chum the Waters if you can; it slows you, and the shark knocks you up if the fish lands on you. Twilight Shroud does not remove the fish.
Trade when Fizz has used Urchin Strike, because his dash is on a long cooldown and he will struggle to get in on you.
Stay out of Justice Punch's line. Galio steps back first, so a quick sidestep or dash can avoid it.
Do not dive into a Galio who is charging Shield of Durand; it taunts you and cuts the damage he takes.
Poke with Five Point Strike at long range so the enemy is slowed, and trade when Galio's Shield of Durand is on cooldown.
Watch for Hero's Entrance from the enemy team; Galio can land far away and knock you up, so stay spread out.
Step out of the Winds of War tornado quickly; it deals damage based on your health.
Dash in with Perfect Execution when Hwei has just spent his Torment spells; he is easy to rush down then.
Stay out of his Severing Bolt when you are alone or stuck; it hits much harder then. Keep moving and step aside before it lands.
Use Twilight Shroud to break his aim; he must predict where you walk. Fight from inside the smoke.
Save Shuriken Flip to dash through his Crushing Maw or out of a root, and never stand still in his lava.

comboRefs.note: Smoke dash closes on Hwei unseen, and his abilities are slow skillshots plus a Flee, so he reacts late.

tips.text: Stay out of Irelia's Bladesurge range when you can. Without a minion for her to dash to, she has a hard time reaching you.
Dodge Flawless Duet by moving sideways as the blades close. A stun from it leaves you open to a full combo.
Don't spend your burst on Irelia while she charges Defiant Dance. Wait until the charge ends before you use Perfect Execution.
Use Five Point Strike at max range to poke Irelia when her Ionian Fervor stacks are down. Trade then, not when her stacks are full.
Use Twilight Shroud to break away once Irelia has dived on you. It makes you invisible and speeds you up.
Use Five Point Strike at its edge to slow Kassadin, and keep out of his Null Sphere range.
Kassadin takes less magic damage from Void Stone, so trade carefully before level 6 and wait for your ultimate.
Dodge his Force Pulse cone before you jump in with Shuriken Flip, since being slowed costs you the escape.
Use Twilight Shroud to gain energy and break line of sight when Kassadin chases you with Riftwalk.
Fight Katarina when Shunpo is on cooldown. She has few ways to escape or chase without it.
Stay away from her Daggers on the ground. Picking one up makes her slash everyone nearby and refreshes Shunpo.
Hit Katarina with Five Point Strike at long range so she is slowed. It's hard for her to close the gap.
Back off when Katarina's Death Lotus is ready and you are low. Hide in Twilight Shroud to break the fight.
Hold Perfect Execution for when Katarina uses Shunpo. She can't dodge without it, and her low health makes her easy to finish.

comboRefs.note: Smoke hides Akali's approach, and the Shuriken dash closes distance on Katarina without being seen.

tips.text: Use Five Point Strike at long range so the enemy is slowed, but only with enough energy to follow up.
Step out of the line of Ethereal Chains; if you are shackled, break away before it roots you.
Hit LeBlanc first; she is weaker when she has already used Distortion, and her tricks mostly fail.
Stay out of long range when Sigil of Malice is ready, because it marks you for a second hit.
Drop Twilight Shroud to break away after a trade, and use Shuriken Flip to dash back in when she is hurt.
Chase a weakened LeBlanc with Perfect Execution, but be aware that she turns invisible at low health and leaves a fake behind.
Fight Lissandra when Ring of Frost is on cooldown; without it she has far fewer ways to stop you from jumping out.
Stay out of Ring of Frost range when you jump in with Shuriken Flip; being rooted next to her is how you die.
Hold Twilight Shroud for when Lissandra goes for Frozen Tomb or tries to chase you; the smoke gives you speed and hides you.
Step to the side of Ice Shard, or keep a minion in front of you, so you are not slowed.
Watch for her Glacial Path; she can blink through walls with it, so do not count on terrain to stop her escape.
Use Perfect Execution on her once she has spent her escapes, then finish with the second thrust when she is low.
Stay out of Light Binding's line, ideally behind a minion. Being rooted in range of Lux's follow-up is how you die.
Drop Twilight Shroud to dodge Lux's burst or to close in unseen. She can still hit you with area spells, which briefly reveal you.
Look for the all-in when Lux has used Light Binding. Then Shuriken Flip and Five Point Strike can reach her.
Save Perfect Execution for when Lux is low on health. Her Prismatic Barrier shield can soak the first hit, so wait until it fades.
Leave Lucent Singularity's area quickly. Staying in it keeps you slowed, and the blast hits hard.
Poke Malzahar with Five Point Strike only when his Void Shift is down. While it is up, he takes very little damage from you.
Fight when his Call of the Void is on cooldown. Once he is silenced you can't cast, so stay out of the line between the two portals.
Hold Perfect Execution until Malzahar has used Nether Grasp or Void Shift is gone. Then you can finish him without his protection.
Use Twilight Shroud to dodge his combo and to reposition. You can't be seen inside the smoke, so he must guess where you are.
Use Shuriken Flip to dash out of range of his Nether Grasp, or to close in on him once Call of the Void is spent.
Walk up and trade when Mel has just used Rebuttal; she has little protection left and Shuriken Flip will land.
Mel's Rebuttal destroys projectiles, so throw Shuriken Flip after she has used it, not into it.
Step out of the way of Solar Snare; being rooted in the middle of her damage is how you die. Use Twilight Shroud to get away from her slowing field.
Back off when you are low on health; the more Mel hits you, the more Overwhelm stacks build up, and she can execute you.
Use Perfect Execution on Mel once she has spent her Rebuttal and Solar Snare; she cannot easily answer the dash.
Use Twilight Shroud when Naafiri commits to a trade; you turn invisible inside the smoke and she loses her target.
Hold Perfect Execution until Naafiri is hurt. Its second thrust hits harder the lower her Health is.
Hit Naafiri with Five Point Strike at the tip of its range so she is slowed, then step away from her trade.
Save Shuriken Flip to escape after she dives you, or to chase her when she flees. The recast dash follows the marked target.
Watch your Energy before you trade; Naafiri gets her best chance to fight you when you run low.

comboRefs.note: Stealthy shroud gap close lets Akali reach Naafiri, though her packmates still attack what Akali targets.

tips.text: Stay out of Orianna's Ball range; her spells only hit around the Ball, so check where it sits before you go in.
Wait until Orianna spends Command: Shockwave before diving with Perfect Execution, or she can pull you back in and stun you.
Use Five Point Strike at max range to slow her, and keep out of the field from Command: Dissonance.
Sidestep Command: Attack; it is a narrow line, and her shield from Command: Protect is weaker once she has spent it.

comboRefs.note: Smoke and Shuriken Flip dash let Akali close in on Orianna, who has Shockwave to punish the dive.

tips.text: Cast Twilight Shroud when Qiyana dives on you; you turn invisible inside the smoke and she loses her target.
Fight Qiyana when she has no element. Her Elemental Wrath loses its root and extra damage then.
Hit Qiyana with Five Point Strike at the tip of its range so she is slowed and cannot easily dash back onto you.
Keep Perfect Execution for when Qiyana is low on health. Its second dash hurts more the less health she has.
Stay out of Qiyana's ultimate range near walls and river. Use Shuriken Flip to leave before the blast goes off.
Don't trade while Ryze has Flux on you. Overload then hits harder and Rune Prison roots you instead of slowing.
Stay at the edge of your range with Five Point Strike so the enemy is slowed. Ryze then struggles to catch you.
Use Shuriken Flip to dash in and out. It also marks Ryze, so you can recast it to close the gap.
Kill Ryze with Perfect Execution. Hit him with the recast when he is hurt for the biggest damage.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape when Ryze catches you, or to restore Energy before you strike again.
Fight Sylas when his Kingslayer is on cooldown; it is his main way to heal and punish you in a trade.
Duck into Twilight Shroud when Sylas lines up Abduct; he needs to see you to hit you.
Hit Sylas with Five Point Strike at the edge of its range so he is slowed, then follow with Shuriken Flip.
Hold Perfect Execution until Sylas is low. Its second dash hurts more the less Health he has.
Do not use Perfect Execution while Hijack is ready; Sylas can steal it and use it on you.

comboRefs.note: Buffered Q lands as the dash ends, slowing Sylas with Five Point Strike's tip as she closes in.

tips.text: Close the gap with Perfect Execution when Syndra has used Scatter the Weak; her main escape is on a long cooldown, so she is easier to catch.
Step out of Dark Sphere's landing spot; it appears after a short delay, so keep moving while you trade.
Do not stand near a lingering Dark Sphere. Scatter the Weak can knock it into you and stun you.
Use Twilight Shroud to hide and reset when your energy is low or Syndra is hunting you. It also refills your energy.
Use Shuriken Flip to dash back out after a trade, then recast it to return and finish her.
Stay healthy once Syndra has her ultimate. Unleashed Power hits hard when many spheres are around, so do not fight with low Health.

comboRefs.note: Smoke hides Akali's approach, helping her close in on Syndra, who has no listed way to stop a dash.
Dashing in and landing Q at once gives Syndra little time to react before Akali's kunai hit.

tips.text: Stay out of Unraveled Earth's stones; if Taliyah knocks you or you dash through them, you get stunned. Walk around the field instead.
Watch for Seismic Shove's marked ground. It lands after a short delay, so step out of the area before it rises.
Sidestep Threaded Volley; the rocks fly in a fixed line. Taliyah's follow-up boulder slows you, so don't stand on her Worked Ground.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape or to wait out her cooldowns. Her area spells can still hit you inside it and briefly reveal you.
Go in with Perfect Execution once Seismic Shove is on cooldown. Taliyah has little to stop you after that.
Do not dash in with Shuriken Flip while her stones are on the ground; the dash sets them off and stuns you.
Use Twilight Shroud when Talon jumps in; he can lose you inside the smoke, and the speed boost lets you walk away from his follow-up.
Hold Perfect Execution until Talon is hurt, then use the second thrust to finish him, since it hits harder the lower his Health is.
Fight Talon with Five Point Strike at full range so he is slowed, and trade when your Energy is high.
Look for Shadow Assault being on cooldown, then go in on Talon, because he has no easy escape.
Use Shuriken Flip to dash back out after a trade so Talon cannot punish you for staying.

comboRefs.note: Smoke hides the approach, and the dash lets Akali close on Talon even after he goes invisible.

tips.text: Fight when Twisted Fate's Pick a Card is on cooldown; the Gold Card stun is his best answer to your dive.
Sidestep Wild Cards while you farm; they are his main way to poke you down.
Twisted Fate's Destiny reveals you even in Twilight Shroud, so don't count on hiding while it is active.
Hit him with Five Point Strike at its edge so he is slowed, then follow with Shuriken Flip to close in.
Walk around Event Horizon's cage edge instead of through it; touching the edge stuns you, and Veigar will follow with Dark Matter.
Bait out Event Horizon before you go in; with it on cooldown, Veigar has little way to stop you.
Keep moving when Dark Matter is falling; it has a delay and can be dodged by sidestepping.
Hit Veigar with Five Point Strike at full range to slow him, then punish him; he is very fragile.
Don't let your health drop low near Veigar; Primordial Burst hits harder the less health you have.
Do not dash into Vex with Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution while her fear is ready; the fear interrupts dashes and leaves you open.
Every dash you make near Vex marks you with Gloom, so expect extra damage from her next attack or basic ability.
Use Twilight Shroud to escape Vex's slow from Looming Darkness. Fight her while her shield and fear are on cooldown.
Hit Vex with Five Point Strike at the edge of its range so she is slowed, then trade before she can answer.

comboRefs.note: The Shuriken Flip recast dash can be interrupted by Vex's empowered fear, so the buffered Q may never go out.

tips.text: Dash onto Viktor with Shuriken Flip's recast when he is out of position; he has no escape from you once you are on him.
Stay out of Gravity Field. Walk out of it quickly before the stun lands, and never fight inside it.
Step sideways out of Hextech Ray instead of walking straight along it; it is a narrow line.
Drop Twilight Shroud to escape or reset a fight. Viktor can still hit you with area spells, which reveals you briefly.
Hit Viktor with Five Point Strike at its far tip so he is slowed, then close in with Shuriken Flip.
Use Perfect Execution on a weakened Viktor; the second thrust hurts more the lower his health is.
Stay out of Transfusion range and fight Vladimir early before he builds health. Once he has the health, he is much sturdier.
Wait out Sanguine Pool before you use Perfect Execution; he can't be targeted in it and it slows you.
Hit Vladimir with Five Point Strike at its far edge to slow him, then leave before he can cast Tides of Blood.
Don't stay in Hemoplague. Retreat or hide in Twilight Shroud, because he takes a lot of healing from it.
Stay out of his Shocking Orb line; it stuns the first enemy it hits, so walk at an angle or keep a minion in front of you.
Close the distance with Shuriken Flip, then recast to dash onto him. Xerath has no easy escape once you are on top of him.
Step into Twilight Shroud when he aims Eye of Destruction or Arcanopulse at you. It restores your energy and makes you hard to target.
Hit him with Five Point Strike at its far tip when he is charging Arcanopulse. He is already slowed and cannot dodge well.
Use Perfect Execution at level 6 to jump on him when he is low. He has no dash, so the second thrust usually finishes him.
Stay at the far edge of Five Point Strike range so the slow lands, and Xin Zhao has to work to reach you.
Use Shuriken Flip to jump back out when Xin Zhao charges in, then come back in with the recast.
Don't let Xin Zhao land a third Three Talon Strike hit; the knock up leaves you stuck next to him.
Save Twilight Shroud to slip away after his Audacious Charge, and don't stand in a straight line from Wind Becomes Lightning.
Don't jump in with Perfect Execution while Crescent Guard is ready; it can knock you back, and his guard blocks your follow-up.
Drop Twilight Shroud on yourself when Yasuo tries to trade; he can't see you inside, and the smoke gives you speed to walk away or reset.
Poke with Five Point Strike at its far tip so Yasuo is slowed, then step back before he can dash onto you.
Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks Five Point Strike and Shuriken Flip. Wait for it to fall before you throw them.
Hold Perfect Execution until Yasuo is hurt. The second dash hits harder the lower his health is.
Stay out of Steel Tempest's range and sidestep it. When he has two stacks, expect a whirlwind that knocks you up.
Trade with Five Point Strike at its far tip so the enemy is slowed, then step away before Yone can answer.
When Yone dashes in with a spirit form, use Twilight Shroud to break his fight and reposition rather than trading blindly.
Use Shuriken Flip to jump in and out of a trade. Recast it only when the dash is safe.
Hold Perfect Execution for when Yone is low. Its second dash hurts more the less health he has.
Keep your distance when Yone has two Mortal Steel stacks, since his next one dashes and knocks you up.

comboRefs.note: Shroud hides the approach, so you can dash in and trade before Yone reacts to your engage.

tips.text: Hold Twilight Shroud for when Zed commits Death Mark; the smoke hides you and the speed boost helps you get out.
Trade right after Zed uses Living Shadow, when his damage and escape are on cooldown.
Hit Zed with Five Point Strike at the tip of its range so he is slowed, then leave before his shadows join in.
Use Shuriken Flip to hit him, then recast to close the gap when he is weak. It also dashes you back away when you throw it.
Save Perfect Execution to finish Zed when he is low, or to jump away when he is on top of you. The second dash hurts more the lower he is.
Stay out of Sleepy Trouble Bubble's line, since a sleeping Akali takes extra damage. Walk around minions so the bubble hits them first.
Punish Zoe right after she misses Sleepy Trouble Bubble; her best tool is on a long cooldown and she is easier to catch.
Zoe's Paddle Star! hits hardest from far away, so close the gap and fight her up close.
Use Twilight Shroud to turn invisible and break her aim, then come out with Shuriken Flip to close in.
After Zoe uses Portal Jump she cannot move and must return to where she started. Dive onto that spot with Perfect Execution.
Go for the kill at level 6 once she is hurt; the second Perfect Execution cast hits harder the lower her health is.
